popCulture.title: Bibliotheca
popCulture.creator: Pseudo-Apollodorus
popCulture.description: Minyan king of Orchomenus who exacts tribute from Thebes until young Heracles arms the citizens and breaks the levy — distinct from Erginus the Argonaut of Miletus.

popCulture.title: Erginus (king of Orchomenus)
popCulture.description: Last Minyan overlord of Thebes until Heracles ends the tribute — not Erginus son of Poseidon the Argonaut.
